description: ROBOTIS's open humanoid research platform: 20 XM430-W350 Dynamixel servos on a TTL bus, an OpenCR sub-controller and an Intel NUC on top, with a Logitech C920 for eyes. Values are from the ROBOTIS e-Manual (OP3 introduction; XM430-W350 page).
name: robotis-op3

nodes.label: OpenCR sub-controller
nodes.req_label: distributes battery power onto the Dynamixel bus

nodes.label: XM430-W350-R servos (×20)
nodes.req_label: documented input range 10.0–14.8 V; stall torque 3.8 N·m at 11.1 V

wiring.note: The OP3's documented pattern: the battery powers the OpenCR sub-controller, and the OpenCR distributes power and data to all twenty XM430-W350 servos over the daisy-chained Dynamixel TTL bus. The servos' documented input range is 10.0–14.8 V (rated_max_v records the 11.1 V bus voltage this robot actually runs). The Intel NUC's own power feed is not part of the documented bus and is not shown.
